title: Persian Rice Stuffed Vegetables
subtitle: butternut, baby eggplant, zucchini and capsicum
description: Butternut squash, baby eggplants, zucchini and capsicums filled with a herby, spiced rice and pine nut stuffing and simmered in a tomato sauce.

steps.text: Soak the rice in lukewarm water with 0.5 teaspoon of salt for about 1 hour, then drain.

Cut off the wide base of the squash and scoop out the flesh and seeds with a small knife. Hollow out the eggplants and zucchini in the same way. Cut the tops off the capsicums and remove the seeds and white membranes.

Heat the olive oil in a pan and fry the chopped onions for 7 minutes until golden. Add the rice and the remaining filling ingredients and fry for 1-2 minutes until the grains are coated in oil. Adjust the seasoning, remove from the heat and fill all the vegetables with the mixture.

For the sauce, heat the oil in a pot and fry the diced tomatoes for 2 minutes until soft. Pour in the stock and tomato paste, season with salt and white pepper, bring to the boil and reduce for about 2 minutes over high heat.
Arrange the vegetables in a single layer in a wide pot, pour the sauce between them and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for 50 minutes. Serve hot.
